primary_dependency_interfaces.checked: Global monotonicity and local uniform ellipticity suffice; no global uniform constant required.
Weighted gradient bound, smooth ball Dirichlet hypotheses; no additional u<=0 assumption.
Hessian Radon measures for all k>=2, distinct from k>n/2 hypothesis of other conclusions.

rejected_concerns: Degenerating Jacobi coefficient is handled by the negative-eigenvalue gradient-term regime; dynamic-boundary equality is covered.
Correct rescaled squared norm has t^(4k)||u||^2; finite iteration preserves claimed qualitative constant dependence.
Taylor derivatives at x replace displayed 0, or coordinates are centered at x; subsequent proof uses centered remainder.
Little-oh mean estimate supplies tau^(n+1) choice and bad volume <tau^n, completing Lemma4.2 without added assumptions.
The shifted pure Hessian operator is globally elliptic and locally uniformly elliptic, as Savin requires.
Higher-dimensional approximation need not preserve the dynamic condition for the separate differentiability step.
No unrestricted higher-dimensional viscosity regularity is claimed.
